candidates.label: One stream per ontology artifact instance
evidence: CAL-PROP-0001 locates one logical artifact record inside one owner-local capability-instance envelope.

candidates.label: One stream per concept or relation
evidence: Per-subject streams preserve owner-locality but require cross-stream consistency and recomposition.

candidates.label: One global repository ontology stream
evidence: CAL-PROP-0001 requires owner-local artifacts and typed directional cross-context relations.
rejectionReasons: A global stream collapses owner-local bounded contexts and turns repository placement into a semantic and authority boundary.

candidates.label: Defer stream granularity
evidence: Deferral prevents reducer and storage construction from starting.

candidates.label: Stop stream design
evidence: Stopping terminates stream design without repository effects.
